title: Requirements Rubric
description: A published, openly licensed list of requirements for emergency call-taking protocols (a state administrative rule, a national curriculum), encoded so packs can be measured against it. Each requirement carries its citation and a deterministic check evaluated against a loaded pack. Rubrics are the project's safe comparison story: we measure the open corpus against public requirements, never against proprietary protocols (docs/PRIVATE-PACKS.md).

scope.description: Discipline the rubric governs, e.g. 'emd' (emergency medical dispatch). Packs outside the scope are reported but not scored.

jurisdiction.description: e.g. US-ME, or US for national

instrument.description: The document that imposes the requirements

taxonomies.description: Named classification lists the rubric's requirements refer to (e.g. the NHTSA 32 chief complaint types). Referenced as '<rubricId>#<key>' by complaints checks.

patterns.description: Case-insensitive regexes matched against protocol names and keywords in every declared locale.

citation.description: Where in the instrument this requirement appears

text.description: The requirement, in the instrument's own terms

appliesTo.description: 'pack' — a property of the protocol content itself, and therefore scored. 'program' — a property of the agency's programme (QA/QI, training, record-keeping, mass-casualty plans); reported for completeness, never scored against a pack.

slot.description: caseEntry: regex matched against question slot and id

firstSlot.description: caseEntryOrder: regex for the question that must come first

thenSlot.description: caseEntryOrder: regex for the question that must come after

min.description: caseEntry/responseLevels/complaints: minimum count for a full pass

minProtocols.description: keyQuestions/postDispatch: how many protocols must carry the section

minSteps.description: postDispatch: minimum ordered steps in at least one protocol (a scripted instruction sequence)

patterns.description: text: case-insensitive regexes; met when all match, partial when some do

textScope.description: text: which of the pack's utterances to search (default 'all')

note.description: notRepresentable/manual: why the check cannot be automated
